clauses.scope_note: Use of the Software license terminates automatically, without notice, upon failure to comply with any Agreement term or expiration or cancellation of the Subscription.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies once the Licensee breaches an Agreement term or the Subscription expires or is cancelled.

clauses.scope_note: Upon termination, the Licensee must immediately stop using the Software and destroy all copies in its possession or control, including modified versions.
clauses.condition_explanation: The obligation is triggered by termination of the Agreement.

clauses.scope_note: The text states that listed sections survive termination, including Section 2(d) on Output ownership and Section 4 on restrictions. This clause does not reproduce those sections or establish their full terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: The survival provision applies upon termination; it identifies provisions that continue but does not itself specify their substantive permissions or restrictions.

clauses.scope_note: The Licensor may terminate the Agreement or any Subscription at any time for cause, including violations of Section 4 restrictions; this is a termination power, not an independent use restriction.
clauses.condition_explanation: The clause applies when the Licensor terminates for cause. It gives violation of Section 4 as a non-exhaustive example.

clauses.scope_note: The Licensee may not assign or transfer the Agreement or any rights or obligations under it without the Licensor’s prior written consent. The clause does not expressly address sublicensing as distinct from assignment or transfer.
clauses.condition_explanation: Assignment or transfer is prohibited absent the Licensor’s prior written consent.

clauses.scope_note: Continued use after the Licensor modifies the Agreement constitutes acceptance of the modified terms; the clause does not state the full scope or timing of any modification.
clauses.condition_explanation: If the Licensee continues using the Software after a modification, that continued use constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.

clauses.scope_note: The Licensee must comply with applicable export control laws and regulations in its use of the Software.
clauses.condition_explanation: The obligation applies to the Licensee’s use of the Software.
